This is Millennium's app, providing secure 24/7 access to your bank account. In addition to checking balances and transactions, it offers a wide range of operations and products. 

Plus, it comes with various user-friendly features to simplify your banking.

Here are some of them.

Open an account with Digital Mobile Key
Go paperless and open your Millennium account within minutes using Mobile Digital Key without the need for in-person visits.

MB WAY
Use MB WAY within the Millennium app to make mobile payments, send money to friends, and more.

Payments and Transfers
In the bottom navigation bar, you'll find these two quick options to make your everyday payments and transfers.

Apple Pay
Leave your wallet at home and make your secure payments with your iPhone or Apple Watch, using contactless technology.

StayON
With StayON, everything is centralized in one place: notification history, documents, pending transactions, Banco Mail, your account manager, and much more.


Apparte
Save money with goals using Apparte. Then set up automatic transfer rules, so you don't have to worry about a thing. You can also build your emergency fund.


Cards
All our cards now come with a digital twin version that you can use as soon as the card is approved in the app. And remember, the decision is instant.

Block cards
If you've lost your card or won't be using it for a while, you can block it in the app. When you're ready to use it again, just unblock it.

Installments
Split your credit card purchases starting from €100 into installments of 3, 6, or 9 months.

Data update with Digital Mobile Key
It's essential that you keep your personal details up to date to continue making transactions. You can update them in minutes using the Digital Mobile Key.

Direct debits
Edit or cancel your direct debits without having to go to an ATM.

Get salary paid at Millennium
We can assist you through the app and even provide a template email with your IBAN for your employer.

Salary advance
Want to get a salary advance on the 1st day of each month? Send us your application. If approved, and if you've already received a salary before, you'll receive that amount in advance on the 1st day of each month.

Privacy mode
Before entering the app, activate the option to hide balances and prevent prying eyes when you're in public.

Notifications
Get real-time notifications when your salary is deposited, when a direct debit is scheduled, when you make card payments, and much more.

Touch ID and Face ID
Use your phone's Touch ID or Face ID to log in to the app and authorize transactions.

Insurance
Get Médis health insurance, Médis Dental (only €9.90/month), Móbis car insurance, YOLO! life insurance, and ON/OFF travel insurance (for just €1.25/day).

Personal and auto loans
Skip the paperwork and apply for a personal or used car loan with an instant response.

“How Much Can I Borrow" calculator
If you're considering buying a home, use our "How Much Can I Borrow" calculator to quickly determine the loan amount you're eligible for.

Mortgage loan
Once you know how much you can apply for, start your mortgage loan application. You can now even submit and sign your application directly within the app.

Investments area
You can subscribe to investment funds, certificates, pension plans, and ETFs. If you prefer, you can also opt for Automated Investment starting from €30, and we'll take care of the rest.

Virtual Assistant
Questions about a feature, product, or banking concept? Our virtual assistant is here to help and can even carry out some operations at your request.
